cohort: CHEMBL3855278 only; exact original source-reported experimental pKi; no predicted labels
split: Murcko scaffolds (nonchiral) grouped, deterministic hash order seed assay-pilot-v1, target 20% holdout. At least 10 train and 5 test; scaffold holdout preferred. If fewer than 2 usable groups or cannot meet sizes, connectivity-group holdout with explicit congeneric-only limitation. Never select split from outcomes.
models: StandardScaler fitted on train + Ridge alpha=1.0
tuning: none; no fit on holdout, no refit on all data
domain: training descriptor min/max and maximum train Morgan similarity (radius 2, 2048 bits, nonchiral); descriptive only, not calibrated confidence
primary_label: Exact source-reported experimental pKi from ChEMBL original value; standard Ki nM and roundtrip pKi retained only as conversion checks, not new measurements.
scope: single-assay exploratory pilot, not external validation, not the old frozen 250-compound model
label_provenance: Source-reported pKi is experimental; ChEMBL standard Ki nM and recomputed pKi are transformations of that same observation.
duplicate_policy: Before label inspection, cohort curator excludes every full-isomeric parent identity with multiple source records regardless of values; unresolved replicate mapping is not averaged. All records retained in ledger.
endpoint_decision: Parent clarified original source pKi preferred before any fit or metric inspection.
structure_policy: Use cohort-curated parent_smiles, preserving source_canonical_smiles and ledger; no additional model-side neutralization/tautomerization.
